title: When mercy makes gratitude honest
subtitle: For the hour when gift is near but entitlement speaks first
description: A brief return to the confession that grace was already working before you noticed it. It lets gratitude become humility, not self-congratulation.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Gratitude begins by admitting unworthiness and recognizing the pity that brought the True Guru near.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Name one mercy you did not earn, then let that remembrance make the next act gentler.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle begins where the shabad begins, with the heart confessing it did not appreciate what the Lord had already done.
evidence.turn: For when lack is louder than the mercy that has been carrying you
evidence.practicalImplication: Move from honest confession into practice and shabad so thankfulness becomes received humility instead of a mood.
